# DentX Dental Lab

> Premium digital dental laboratory in Tarzana, California, shipping to dental offices across the United States. Digital shade matching. Digital cases from Medit, iTero, Shining 3D, DEXIS IOS Cloud or STL.

- Legal name: DentX Dental Lab Inc
- Address: 18401 Burbank Blvd #110, Tarzana, CA 91356
- Phone: +1 (818) 687-0085
- Email: Dentxdentallab@yahoo.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 9 am–6 pm
- Audience: dentists and dental office managers (not patients)

## Shipping
- Los Angeles County: Free pickup and delivery by our own driver. Call or text before 12 pm and we'll do our best to pick up the same day.
- Outside LA County, digital: Send your scan. Finished work ships back for $7 per case.
- Outside LA County, impressions: We email you a prepaid label, billed at the carrier's cost. Finished work ships back for $7 per case.

## Turnaround (business days in the lab, from arrival) and prices
### Metal-free / full ceramic
- Zirconia crown: 5 days, $75
- E.max crown: 5 days, $85
- Veneers: 5 days, $99
- Layered zirconia / E.max: 6 days, $99
- Inlay / onlay: 5 days, $75
- PMMA temporary crown: 5 days, $45
- Diagnostic wax-up: 4 days, $25
### Implant & attachments
- Implant crown, screw retained: 5 days, $130
- Implant crown, cement retained: 5 days, $120
- Custom abutment, milled: $230
- Surgical guide: $95
- Verification jig: $60
- Soft tissue: $15
### Removable
- Acrylic denture: 6 · 7 · 7 days, $180 (Bite block · teeth try-in · final finish)
- Printed denture: 7 days, $160
- Metal partial: 11 · 7 · 7 days, $230 (Metal try-in · teeth try-in · final finish)
- Valplast: 6 · 7 · 12 days, $230 (Bite block · teeth try-in · final finish)
- Combination: 12 days, $250 (Metal + Valplast)
- Stayplate, acrylic: 4 days, $95 (Per arch, up to 3 units · 4+ units $110)
- Printed flexible stayplate: 4 days, $85 (Per arch)
- Stayplate rush: 2 days, +$50 (Rush fee)
- Night guard: 3 days, $85 (Hard or soft)
- Repair / reline: 2 days, $60 (Soft reline $80 · excluding delivery time)

### Guides
- [Dental Lab Guides for Dentists](https://www.dentxdentallab.com/guides/): Practical guides from DentX Dental Lab: zirconia vs E.max, monolithic vs layered zirconia, how to send a case, the Rx checklist and turnaround times.
- [Zirconia vs E.max Crowns: Which to Prescribe](https://www.dentxdentallab.com/guides/zirconia-vs-emax/): Zirconia vs E.max (lithium disilicate): strength, esthetics, prep depth and cementation, and when a dental lab recommends each. Prices: zirconia $75, E.max $85.
- [Monolithic vs Layered Zirconia Crowns](https://www.dentxdentallab.com/guides/monolithic-vs-layered-zirconia/): Monolithic zirconia ($75) for strength, layered zirconia ($99) for anterior esthetics. How a dental lab decides, chipping risk, and turnaround.
- [How to Send a Case to a Dental Lab](https://www.dentxdentallab.com/guides/how-to-send-a-case-to-a-dental-lab/): Step-by-step: send a digital scan or impressions to a dental lab, what to include, how pickup and shipping work, and how turnaround is counted.
- [Dental Lab Rx Checklist: What to Include](https://www.dentxdentallab.com/guides/dental-lab-rx-checklist/): What to put on a dental lab prescription so the case starts on time: service, teeth, shade, stump shade, due date, license. Free printable DentX lab slip.
- [Dental Lab Turnaround Times Explained](https://www.dentxdentallab.com/guides/dental-lab-turnaround-times/): How dental lab turnaround is counted: business days in the lab from arrival with a complete Rx. Crowns 5 days, layered 6, night guards 3, dentures by stage.
